note: The handed-over renders (scratchpad/r2, r2st, r2v) predate commit eedb9fa (seam colour #959aa0 -> #a7abb0, 20:59 vs renders 20:51-20:58). The near fitting in b_lalf_c119 (570..720, 0..80) is about 2.5-3.5:1, so the current 0.34 x 0.10 is acceptable.

EXIT signs are double-faced, so no dark backs from the door area
Bin seams are now a mid-grey hairline (p2_placardC), not a black arc

partlyFixed: Outboard PSU band tone: q15 (150,130) was #a6a6a6, now #c1c1c1; photo y_47300 (150,118) #d6d6d9. Still about 22 levels dark.
Centre channel width: 0.84 -> 0.60 m, but still about 1.5x too wide (see issue 2)
Centre PSU: one-row stadium wells, but the O2 plate outline still reads as a rectangle, and the sign window is too small
Outboard door top rail: built, but the row placard on it is now INVISIBLE (issue 1)

The luminous cove band between the bin crest and the grille is far narrower than in the photos (new finding, issue 3)

details.detail: Aisle vault panels and joints. The 2-frame arched joints are right. The vault by the cove is #fbfbfb (q15 215,50) against photo #f5f5f5, which is right. The new fade toward the centre bin works in night-lit photos (b_sany_y22), but it overshoots the official bright scene. In q15, the inboard vault and centre-bin door read #abafb6..#c1c2c5 at (250,60)/(300,20)/(620,40), while y_47300 reads #dddddb/#f4f4f4/#f5f5f5 at the same points.

Cove lighting. It is now on the outboard edge only, which is correct. But the lit band between the outboard-bin crest and the grille is about 2x the grille width in every real photo, and the model shows a sliver: in c119 the band is about 215 px against 90 px of grille; in sany_py_10 it is 75 px against 40 px. The model has about 0.04 m of band visible (p1: about 30 px against 45 px of grille; the mirrored v2 crop shows none). The LED at x=1.70 sits behind the door crest at x 1.64.

Slotted grille. Orientation, side, segmenting and bridges are now right. The slot look is wrong: the photos show thin, near-black slits in white bars (luma min 0-30, dark fraction 0.14-0.30 in c119/py10/y22). The model has wide mid-grey slots (#7f848a, 7 of 12 px; luma min 123-130, dark fraction 0.25-0.42). So it reads as a heavy grey hatched stripe at distance (q15), where y_47300 shows only faint lines. The grille also sits flush against the bin crest, not inboard of a lit band.
Outboard bins. Door shape, 2-frame modules, stadium latch and hairline seams are OK. The top rail exists, but the placard on it faces the ceiling (issue 1).

Centre bins. The seams are now thin grey, and the centre placards are readable (p2: '34', '35'). The channel is still too wide, so the broad rolled lower door wraps seen in b_sany_y22 and c119 are compressed. The doors are too dark in the bright scene (see vault). The centre placard shows a visible light plate (#f6f7f9 ground against the door) where the photo placard is printed directly ('15 D', c119 at 785,210).
Latches. Fixed: full stadium, light rim, dark well, paddle. The size and height match c119 and thrifty.

Outboard PSUs. Recessed transverse stadium wells with 2 fittings: right. The recess reads as a crisp dark outline ring (BINMAT.wellRim), where thrifty_j_overhead-vent shows a deep dish with soft bevelled walls and no dark line. The band is one flat plate with hairline joints, while the photo shows separate stepped panels (the fitting panel stands proud) and ribbed filler strips at about 3 cm pitch.
Outboard PSU band tone: #c1c1c1 at q15 (150,130) against #d6d6d9 in y_47300. Better than round 1 (#a6a6a6) but still about 22 levels dark.

Centre PSU channel (Y). Two transverse rows per seat group are supported by y_47300. But well width over channel width is 0.43 in the model, against 0.77 in y_47300 and 0.67 in b_sany_y22. The O2 plate still reads as an outlined rectangle (v6 at 500..620, 220..240; z_q15_chan), and no photo shows one. There are 8 dark joint lines per module, a ruled 'ladder' look; y_47300 is nearly plain. An unverified blue call square sits beside the sign.

No-smoking and fasten-belt signs. The icons and smoked lens are right. On the centre channel the real window is a long dark stadium, about 0.8 of the channel width, with the icons centred (b_sany_y22 crop). The model's centre window is 0.13 x 0.042 m, about 0.22 of the channel, a small pill. The outboard sign pill matches thrifty.

Row placards. Centre bins: readable (p2). Outboard bins: not visible in any view (p1 close-up, v2, v6, q15), while py_37302, thrifty_j_cabin-1 and b_sany_y22 all show readable numerals on the outboard top rail.
Ceiling EXIT signs. The bilingual red-on-light face is right, and the signs are now double-faced (v3, v7).

Vault fittings. The speaker at 0.34 x 0.10 is acceptable (see note). It is a full stadium (r = d/2), where the photos show a rounded rectangle with squarer ends (c119 near fitting, z_th_fit). The emergency light is still inverted: model black frame with white lens (v2 at 608,200; v6 at 222,178), photo light frame with a shadowed grey slot (z_th_fit at 50..145, 95..130; c119 at 428,243).

Door-area ceilings. The tone is now #dddddb..#e2e1e0 against a #f7 vault, which is acceptable. It is still unverified against any photo. At door 3 a flat bright panel carries a thick black frame (v3 at 0..600, 0..95), probably the unlit side faces of the CEILMAT.lightPanel gRBox, or of a monument panel.

issues.problem: placardXF puts the outboard placard at faceAtY(OBIN_DOOR, 2.19). Above the door's most aisle-ward point (x 1.469, y 2.03), OBIN_DOOR curves outboard, so at y 2.19 the face normal points about 55 deg upward: tangent (0.052, 0.036), aisle normal (-0.57, +0.82). From any eye height of 1.2-1.75 m the view ray is at grazing incidence (dot = -0.005 from (0.5, 1.6); -0.06 from the p1 camera), so the quad renders as nothing. The same applies to the rail, which spans y 2.163-2.22.
issues.evidence: p1_placardL.png (0.9 m from the left bin at row 34, looking up at it): rail visible, no placard. p2_placardC.png (centre bin, same distance): '34'/'35' readable. py_37302 at (160,10), thrifty_j_cabin-1 ('13', '14' at 1400,260 and 1000,295) and b_sany_y22 ('32') all show readable outboard placards.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js: put the rail and placard on the aisle-facing part of the door. Set RAIL_Y = 2.105 and build the rail from 2.105 to 2.155 (filter p[1] > RAIL_Y+0.005 && p[1] < 2.16). In placardXF use faceAtY(OBIN_DOOR, 2.13) with off 0.0105. Move the latch down to faceAtY(OBIN_DOOR, 2.0) so it stays about 44 % down the door (thrifty). Alternative: steepen the door top so it stays near-vertical to 2.2 — OBIN_DOOR ... [1.469,2.03],[1.472,2.12],[1.484,2.18],[1.52,2.215],[1.64,2.228] — and keep RAIL_Y. Check: dot(view, normal) < -0.3 from (0.5, 1.6).

issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: TROUGH.ts = [0.22] (grille centred at x of about 1.45). In eFn make the strip from the vault start to the grille a luminous band: if (ax > xg + TROUGH.w/2) return 0.95; else keep the decay 0.04 + 0.30*exp(-(xg-ax)/0.16) inboard of the grille. Move the speaker fitting to t 0.80 and the emergency light to t 0.55 so they stay on the plain vault.
